<thought>The 13C NMR list shows peaks at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (twice), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, 116.65 (twice) – all within the typical aromatic carbon range (≈110‑160 ppm). The 166.00 ppm peak is a carbonyl, and the remaining low-field peaks (61.10, 14.26) are aliphatic. Counting the aromatic peaks, including the duplicated ones, gives 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
